title: J046--FY26 | Services | Soft Water | Base + 4 | Bath VAMC
description_text: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 36C24226Q0410 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for chemistry and monthly preventive maintenance of two (2) Pentair soft water generators. The solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquistion.gov. Please see the attached PDF for more information.
